country_identity_reconciliation.consequence: The frozen GT12-A authority binds a coordinate slot literally named COUNTRY_ALPHA3 (rawlsing_next/wave1_r5_q86_c11_projection.py:162-168) on this R5 carrier, but the physical merged R5 SAV stores COUNTRY (numeric) and COUNTRY_ALPHA (numeric, alphabetical order) and does NOT store a COUNTRY_ALPHA3 column. The alpha-3 identity is therefore a derived crosswalk applied by the producer, not a source-native field. This must be reconciled before any three-way projection reuses the coordinate slot; it is a reconciliation item, not an asserted defect.
